title: Length of the Longest Alphabetical Continuous Substring
goal: Find the longest substring whose letters advance consecutively through the alphabet.
strategy: Track the run ending at each character. It extends only when the current letter code is exactly one greater than the preceding code; repeated letters, gaps, and z-to-a reset it.
